import tkinter as tk
from random import choice

class TriviaGame:
    def __init__(self):
        self.window = tk.Tk()
        self.window.title("Trivia Game")
        self.questions = {
            "What is the capital of France?": "Paris",
            "What is the largest planet in our solar system?": "Jupiter",
            "What is the chemical symbol for gold?": "Au"
        }
        self.score = 0
        self.current_question = choice(list(self.questions.keys()))
        self.display_question()

    def display_question(self):
        self.question_label = tk.Label(self.window, text=self.current_question)
        self.question_label.pack()
        self.answer_entry = tk.Entry(self.window)
        self.answer_entry.pack()
        self.submit_button = tk.Button(self.window, text="Submit", command=self.check_answer)
        self.submit_button.pack()

    def check_answer(self):
        user_answer = self.answer_entry.get()
        if user_answer.lower() == self.questions[self.current_question].lower():
            self.score += 1
            self.current_question = choice(list(self.questions.keys()))
            self.display_question()
        else:
            self.question_label['text'] = f"Sorry, that's incorrect. The correct answer was {self.questions[self.current_question]}."

    def run(self):
        self.window.mainloop()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    game = TriviaGame()
    game.run()
```
